hook.name: FlashV3Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Flash protocol that manages token-launch pools with dynamic LP fee overrides, a 1% creator/protocol fee split (90/10), impact taxes on token sells, and churn-deck liquidity (selling token inventory into buys at spot price). Supports multiple quote types (WETH, FLASH, RWA, Perp, custom) with per-pool creator routing, in-swap FLASH buyback triggers, and an always-on ledger sweep for fee distribution.
